question: The Battleship Arsenal sweep: an ultra-deep discovery + verification pass over (A) the GitHub/open-source ecosystem for tooling that lets a lean AI-native SEO agency (King Maker SEO — Claude Code + MCP-based, scaling from 1 to ~5-10 local-contractor clients) operate at battleship readiness, and (B) the 2026 UGC/short-form content-creation stack (Higgsfield, CapCut, AI avatar/UGC tools, automation repos) for a solo founder about to start posting daily marketing content.
subQuestions: GitHub: what are the best ACTIVELY-MAINTAINED (2025-2026 commits) open-source tools for local-SEO agency operations — local rank tracking / geo-grid tools, Google Business Profile management and audit tooling, schema/structured-data generators, citation & NAP tooling, technical site auditors, internal-linking tools, SERP data collectors — and which popular ones are abandoned/broken (verify repo activity, don't trust listicles)?

GitHub: what LLM-agent / AI-powered SEO automation actually exists and works — MCP servers for SEO APIs (DataForSEO, GSC, GBP, Ahrefs-like), programmatic/agentic SEO frameworks, AI content pipelines with quality gates, Claude-Code-adjacent SEO workflows — which are production-usable vs demos, and which carry spam/policy risk?

What self-hostable/open-source stack can run CLIENT OPERATIONS for a 5-10 client agency lean: white-label reporting dashboards, analytics (Plausible/Umami/Matomo class), call-tracking and lead attribution, review monitoring/management, uptime + SERP monitoring, client portals — what do lean agencies actually run in 2026?

The 2026 solo-operator UGC/short-form stack: what are Higgsfield's current strongest capabilities (image/video/avatar/product models as of mid-2026), the CapCut (or superior alternative) editing workflow for daily output, and the leading AI-avatar/UGC-ad tools (HeyGen, Arcads, Captions, etc.) — costs, strengths, what the leanest daily-posting pipeline looks like end to end?

What short-form content formats and hooks are MEASURABLY working in 2025-2026 for B2B-service / local-service marketing audiences (owner-on-camera authority content, audit teardowns, case-study breakdowns, before/after) on TikTok / Reels / Shorts — evidence from creator data, not guru claims?

GitHub/OSS: which video/content automation tools are maintained and production-usable — auto-captioning (Whisper-based pipelines), clip extraction/repurposing, batch rendering (Remotion/FFmpeg frameworks), social-media schedulers/cross-posters — that a solo operator can wire into a Claude-Code-driven content pipeline?
checklist: local rank tracking / geo-grid OSS repos (activity-verified)
SEO MCP servers ecosystem (DataForSEO/GSC/others) on GitHub 2026
programmatic/agentic SEO frameworks (activity + real usage evidence)
AI content pipeline repos with quality gates
Higgsfield capability set mid-2026 (models, avatar/UGC features, pricing)
CapCut pro workflow vs alternatives (Descript, Premiere templates) for daily shorts
AI avatar/UGC ad tools compared (HeyGen, Arcads, Captions, Creatify)
short-form B2B-local content format performance evidence 2025-2026
repo abandonment check: every recommended repo verified active (commits within ~6-12mo)
stopCondition: Every recommended repo/tool is verified active (recent commits or releases) with its niche stated; each stack layer (rank tracking, GBP, schema, reporting, call tracking, captioning, scheduling, avatar/UGC) has at least one production-usable recommendation or an honest 'nothing good exists — buy SaaS X instead'; UGC stack has costs; format-performance claims carry evidence.
